text:
maria_sales: Customer (medtech) asks for a 2-week pilot pinned to Canada + Brazil. Requirements: 95th <200ms and a full list of subprocessors. Need a ballpark cost and timeline today.

luis_tech: Do we have guaranteed in-country hosting for both ca-central1 and sa-east1? They mention nightly spike windows.

samir_sre: ca-central1 hosted ok. sa-east1 hosted capacity is limited; to guarantee no copies outside country we need dedicated pools or Private. Edge nodes help latency but not the "no copies" ask.

maria_sales: They literally put "no cross-border copies" in the sec questionnaire. Does that rule out hosted?

anya_security: For PHI risk, yes  hosted multi-tenant can't guarantee zero copies (backups/metrics/replication). Options: 1) short Dedicated per country, 2) Private (VPC/on-prem). BYOK reduces key risk but doesn't solve metadata/replication.

ops_ashley: I can check quotas and give a provisional cost. Need model size, avg seq, peak qps and duration.

maria_sales: Model ~7B, avg seq 512, peak ~40 qps for ~30m nightly, baseline ~5 qps.

luis_tech: Rough config: 2x A10G-equivalent per country, term 14d, routing policy country_pin (failover:none). Example snippet: ```json
{"routing":{"policy":"country_pin","allowed_countries":["CA","BR"],"replication":"disabled"},"capacity":{"gpus":2}}```

samir_sre: Ballpark cost: order of magnitude $10k-18k per region for 2 weeks (placeholder). Hosted per-token cost lower but fails residency. Ops to confirm exact.

anya_security: I'll prepare minimal subprocessor list (cloud provider, logging, metrics, kms) and SOC2 pointers. If they need in-country auditor contacts for Brazil we'll link CSP public docs; anything beyond that needs legal.

ops_ashley: Timeline to share: quota check today, pricing estimate tomorrow morning, subproc manifest + SOC pointers EOD, provisioning ~48-72h after PO + approvals. Blockers: legal signoff on subproc list and budget.

maria_sales: Great  I'll tell them dedicated option available, BYOK won't fully satisfy "no copies", give rough ballpark and timeline, and ask if Canada-only interim is ok. Will update after ops/security deliver docs. Thanks all :thumbsup:
